g.title: Sheet.210
g.desc: - The Area is an interface property. - Inside the OSPF area, ...
g.text: - The Area is an interface property.- Inside the OSPF area, all router interfaces are assigned to the same area (Area 1).- Routers inside the area have the same LSDB.

g.title: Sheet.218
g.desc: - The Area Border Routers (ABRs) have interfaces in Area 1 an...
g.text: - The Area Border Routers (ABRs) have interfaces in Area 1 and Area 0.- An ABR must always connect to Area 0.
